name: ac-insurance-and-risk-transfer
description: Insurance as risk transfer for individuals and portfolios: identifying the risks worth insuring, coverage limits and deductibles as a trade-off, the policy terms that decide claims, insurer strength and counterparty risk, the interaction with an investment portfolio, and the written coverage record. It explains the mechanics and the questions; it is not insurance advice and never recommends a policy or a carrier. Use when asking "do I need this insurance", "coverage limits", "deductible", "insurer strength", "umbrella policy", "what does my policy cover". Not for portfolio policy (ac-investment-policy-statement), not for tax treatment of premiums (ac-trading-records-and-tax), not for bank credit risk (ac-bank-and-credit-analysis).
